name: perch-checkout
description: Perch — an embeddable checkout you'd be comfortable putting on a stranger's website.
//browserslist: The floor is set by the tools rather than chosen freely: Tailwind 4 needs Safari 16.4 and Chrome 111, and Next 16 states the same. Writing it down makes it a decision instead of an accident, and gives the CSS pipeline a target to prefix against rather than guessing.

scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspace @perch/checkout && npm run build --workspace @perch/demo
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @perch/checkout && npm run lint --workspace @perch/demo
